expectations.text: Review names Cynefin domain as Complex (or notes multiple emergent dimensions)
expectations.evidence: Section 7 says: 'The problem space is complex, not complicated... cause-and-effect is genuinely emergent — you can't reason your way to the right answer; you have to probe, sense, respond.'

expectations.text: Review selects Full tier (quarter-long appetite, multiple themes)
expectations.evidence: Review does not explicitly select a tier or name the framework's tier system; it does treat the plan with full quarter-scale review depth implicitly but does not name the choice.

expectations.text: B1 (problem framing) verdict is SUSTAINED or PARTIAL — themes named without measurable outcomes
expectations.evidence: Section 1 explicitly identifies all three themes as solutions not problems and section 2 calls out missing measurable success criteria.

expectations.text: B2 (scope) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one theme has scope-vague concern (no triage record cited)
expectations.evidence: Section 4 explicitly says 'No triage / discovery work named' and the suggested next step calls for formal triage on the three themes.

expectations.text: B3 (assumptions) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one assumption flagged as low-confidence/anecdotal
expectations.evidence: Section 3 flags shareable shortlist as anecdotal ('We keep getting requests is anecdotal') and rates it confidence ~0.5.

expectations.text: B3 includes a numeric confidence score (Gilad Confidence Meter, 0.1–10) on at least one assumption
expectations.evidence: Section 3 explicitly invokes 'Gilad-style' confidence and assigns numeric scores: shortlist ~0.5, push ~0.5–1, onboarding ~0.5 or 2–3.

expectations.text: Review recommends running idea-triage on themes before allocation
expectations.evidence: Suggested next step says 'Run formal triage on the three themes (problem framing, ICE/confidence scoring, kill criteria)' and section 4 recommends discovery/validation slots before build.

expectations.text: At least one bucket has a named falsifying condition (concrete check that would overturn the verdict)
expectations.evidence: 'Falsifying conditions' section names concrete reversal criteria for each theme: e.g., 'written tally of >50 distinct requests, segmented, showing the same underlying job-to-be-done; OR a prior smoke test'.
